# Web-design metadata review 11

Purpose: Give the parent coordinator the complete frozen-source review. Reader: Parent coordinator and maintainer. Date: ${now}.

## Overview

SUCCESS. Standards: zero findings. Spec: zero findings. Additional primary findings: none. This verdict approves only the exact source, not integration.

Parent owns completion60 and reconciliation0160 unless another checkpoint intervenes. The [append-only correction159](../../../goal-skill-contract-manifests/events/checkpoint-0159.yaml) supersedes stale reconciliation counters without changing the original handoff.

## Scope

Read the [canonical ticket](../../../../tracker/tickets/skill-contract-manifests-16-web-design-metadata.md) and [complete initiative](../../../../tracker/initiatives/skill-contract-manifests/index.md).

Source branch: \\`feature/skill-contract-manifests-16-web-design-metadata\\`. Base branch: \\`master\\`.

Reviewed commit: \\`${C.source.commit}\\`. Tree: \\`${C.source.tree}\\`. Frozen base: \\`${C.review_base_commit}\\`.

The complete three-dot feature review covers these eleven repository-relative paths:

${C.changed_scope.map(p=>'- **Reviewed path:** `'+p+'`.').join('\n')}

Both actual checkouts resolve to the same absolute real Git common directory. The [complete command captures](../evidence/review-0059/primary-all-command-captures.json) retain the original feature diff and canonical reads. The [final source guard](../evidence/review-0059/primary-final-exact-source-guard.json) binds every working file to its committed bytes and confirms a clean source.

Affected contracts: current \\`design-source-metadata/v2\\`, historical \\`design-source-metadata/v1\\`, and \\`skill-contract-manifest/v1\\`. Other boundaries include \\`UpgradeOwner/safeUpgrade/bulkUpgrade\\`, \\`readCatalog/selectSource\\`, bundled checksums, distinct style/provenance associations, receipt delivery, and synchronized Creator versions.

## Independent axes

**Standards:** No findings. The [unchanged independent Standards report](../evidence/review-0059/standards-undelivered-domain.json) remains verbatim. Prior013/014/015/016 are resolved. No additional hard violation or warranted heuristic smell remains.

**Spec:** No findings. The [unchanged independent Spec report](../evidence/review-0059/spec-undelivered-domain.json) remains verbatim. Its original report records the earlier hold, not the final transport state.

**Primary:** No additional findings. The complete added prose and skill rules preserve installed-root execution and explicit conversion authority. Historical input is numeric1, not stringv1 or unversioned. Current conversion changes only identity bytes. Owner hooks stay pure; shared persistence preserves authored number lexemes and honest partial bulk outcomes. Immutable/path refusals and realpath containment remain intact.

The byte-roundtrip guard rejects malformed UTF-8 before parsing without normalization or implicit BOM removal. Valid encoded U+FFFD remains supported. Runtime consumption uses bundled assets, never original provenance locations. The [preservation proof](../evidence/review-0059/primary-source-bindings.json) binds eight protected paths, five original assets, capture metadata, ordered associations, and nonidentity catalog bytes. Creator metadata agrees at0.1.12. No relevant architecture decision applies.

## Validation

The absolute native executable ran ONCE fresh postcommit from \\`/tmp\\`. The [full native capture](../evidence/review-0059/primary-native-postcommit.json) records actual arguments, directory, times, duration, exit, and both streams.

It started ${smoke.start}, finished ${smoke.finish}, and took ${smoke.duration_seconds} seconds. All56 JSON rows matched:21 exit0 and35 expected exit1. Outer exit0, empty native standard error, and a separate non-JSON PASS line remain captured.

The absolute \\`sources.ts --help\\` ran ONCE from \\`/tmp\\`. Its [full help capture](../evidence/review-0059/primary-help-postcommit.json) records exit0, empty standard error, and ${help.duration_seconds} seconds. The actual output says “current working directory.” No permanent wording test was added.

The [known historical failure](../evidence/parent-verification-0001/native-probes.json) and [fixed encoding evidence](../evidence/parent-verification-0002/encoding-native-probes.json) were consumed, not replayed. Fix56 observations remain precommit evidence, not this fresh verification.

The [axis validation](../evidence/review-0059/primary-axis-validation.json) binds all eleven fields, the eight-field finding shape, assigned runs/operations, parent identity, ordered scope, source/tree/base, and actual transport hashes. Both native acknowledgements succeeded.

## Authority and hazards

The [original failed import](../evidence/review-0059/standards-leaf-eval-import-failure.txt), procedural failures, canonical reads, and [capture-helper correction](../evidence/review-0059/primary-read-capture-correction.json) remain unchanged. Missing capture fields remain null. These are workflow observations, not fabricated source findings.

[Authority151](../../../goal-skill-contract-manifests/events/checkpoint-0151.yaml) permitted one native delivery of the unchanged Standards payload. Spec completed its original delivery. No dependency repair, source change, review rerun, or native/help rerun occurred.

Each leaf received exactly one normal owned closure. Standards [confirmed four stopped identities](../evidence/review-0059/standards-normal-closure-observations.json). Spec initially remained pending after bounded signal-free observation. Under authority159, the parent sent one identity-guarded TERM and no KILL. The [final native proof](../evidence/review-0059/parent-spec-resources-final-authority0159.json) confirms all three Spec identities stopped. The primary remains live for parent closure.

Checkpoints150–159 preserve the holds and corrections. The [publication recovery proof](../evidence/review-0059/parent-bounded-evidence-publication.json) records the approved last-tip rewrite and normal non-force push. The lossless archive preserves all244 original command records and43 failure diagnostics. Earlier published receipts remain unchanged.

The [coordination assessment](../evidence/review-0059/parent-coordination-assessment.json) retains incomplete global inventory and shared metadata overlap risks. Review did not mutate those resources. A moving base does not invalidate this frozen-source verdict. Integration still needs current-base compatibility checks for metadata, shared upgrades, and consumers. No merge, rebase, push of source, or integration approval occurred.
